purpose: CL-13 (track M', foundation-closure-list.md): the pause of personal memory between conversations, decided by ZURIEL on 12.11.2026 (D-CL13-1..3). A proposal; nothing here applies SQL. It runs only with ZURIEL's explicit approval of this exact file.

review_point.note: The code, the SQL, the Edge sources and the tests of package 1 are fixed at this commit. Later commits of the branch change documents, one test file (test/cl13-intermediate-states.test.mjs) and the count pinned for it in scripts/run-cl13-personal-memory-handlers-test.sh only (release units, independence statement, CI record); a diff against this SHA that touches anything else changes the review point and must be called out.

independence.database_proposal: INDEPENDENT of M0 and of every other proposed SQL file. It touches only public.agent_user_memory and the memory functions; no other file under supabase/proposed names them (checked by test/cl13-intermediate-states.test.mjs). It has its own state guard and its own exact rollback and can be reviewed, tested and applied as one file.
independence.full_release: NOT independent of M0. The complete CL-13 release is the Edge half of six functions plus the database proposal. Three of the six functions (wa-raziel, ai-analyze, number-researcher) are functions of the M0 Edge package: no build without CL-13 and no CL-13-only build of them exists, so deploying them from this branch ships CL-13 together with M0 and N-deltas, and needs their M0 prerequisites (release_units[].needs_before). A fourth function (raziel-attention) ships the M0-B shared module as a rider. Only wa-hatishbi and wa-uriel carry CL-13 and nothing else.
independence.consequence: The order rule (all six Edge functions before the database step) couples the database step to the M0 Edge approvals, unless the order is decided otherwise (missing_decisions, D-ORDER).

steps.verify: the state text pinned in the file (the md5 of each of the 17 function definitions and the trigger text, enabled); owner, privileges, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path and volatility of the five replaced functions unchanged; no client role may execute a server-only function (all checked inside the file)
steps.what: One policy owner (fn_personal_memory_policy_v1 = the pause); the writers return a real status and write nothing; a trigger on public.agent_user_memory refuses every other writer with an error; fn_raziel_context returns an empty personal context without a verified consent and never in a group; export and erasure of memory without deleting the account. Research (decision of ZURIEL after the Codex review of abb2f3907): authorised research is written and may be read during the pause through one reader (fn_research_output_context_v1); a research row that carries a personal detail is personal memory - refused on write while paused and withheld on read without the person's consent. Profile facts have their own policy key (write_profile_facts): a consent to memory does not open them (D-CL13-3).
steps.preflight: Fail-closed: the file continues only when the state is exactly the live 12.11.2026 state or exactly the applied state.

rollback_order: 1. ROLLBACK file of step CL13-1 (restores the five live bodies exactly, drops the trigger and the twelve new functions). It brings back writing by every writer that ignores the policy and reading without consent in the database: decide that before running it.

2. The Edge code may stay: without the policy function it is closed (no write, no read; the research bots stop reading and storing research), which is tested after the rollback. Rolling the Edge functions back to the deployed sources (the two rollback manifests) restores writing on every message and reading without consent: decide that too.
not_in_this_step: a consent record store and the consent wording (a new store needs its own approval)
the WhatsApp commands that call the export and erasure functions
admin_person_facts (an administrator still reads stored profile facts: an open decision of ZURIEL)

a database-level refusal of direct READS (the trigger covers writes only; PostgreSQL has no read trigger). The direct readers are closed by their own code and pinned by tests; revoking SELECT on the table from the service role and moving every read into a policy-aware function is a possible later hardening, not proposed here

required_order.what: Deploy the Edge code of this branch for ALL SIX functions that read or write personal memory. Each asks public.fn_personal_memory_policy_v1 and is closed while that function does not exist, so the step is safe before the database step (tests BEFORE 0-5).
required_order.state_after_this_step: No stored memory is read and nothing is stored by any of the six (the policy function is missing = closed). The two research bots answer but neither read nor store research until the database step: research needs the database to decide, row by row, what is personal. The stored rows are untouched.
required_order.way_back: Redeploy the deployed sources: docs/reviews/m0-security-stabilization-20261112/edge-rollback/manifest.json (wa-raziel, ai-analyze, number-researcher) and docs/reviews/cl13-personal-memory-20261112/edge-rollback-manifest.json (raziel-attention, wa-hatishbi, wa-uriel). That restores writing on every message and reading without consent.

required_order.what: The database proposal (steps[0]). AFTER EDGE-CL13, never before it.
required_order.state_after_this_step: The pause holds in the database as well: every writer that ignores the policy is refused, fn_raziel_context is closed, and authorised research is written and read through the one reader.
required_order.why_not_first: With the deployed Edge code and the proposal applied, the four direct readers still read the table (nothing in the database stops a direct reader with the service key): the two site threads keep reading the stored thread and prefer it to the new turns, BOTH report persisted=true although the database refused the write (the deployed number-researcher v12 is older than the code on origin/main that checks the answer), and the two research bots still send the stored questions and a personal detail inside a research row to the model. The deployed wa-raziel is closed by the database functions but still records 'facts-captured' for a fact that was not stored (test/cl13-intermediate-states.test.mjs, DB-FIRST 1-3).
required_order.way_back: The ROLLBACK file of steps[0]. The Edge code may stay: without the policy function it is closed (test ROLLBACK).

for: It closes the live collector at once: the deployed wa-raziel and the deployed ai-analyze reach the memory only through the memory functions, and the proposal closes those (tests DB-FIRST 3 on the deployed wa-raziel; for ai-analyze the evidence is static: the deployed source calls only fn_raziel_context and fn_raziel_remember).
It is independent of M0 (independence.database_proposal) and has an exact rollback and a fail-closed state guard.
against: The four direct readers stay as deployed (no regression against today): number-researcher and raziel-attention keep reading the stored thread and prefer it to the new turns and BOTH report persisted=true without a row; the bots keep sending stored questions and a personal detail inside a research row to the model (DB-FIRST 1-2).
The deployed wa-raziel still records [facts-captured] for a fact that was not stored, and still tells a person who links an account that everything is saved.
ai-analyze was not executed in this state (its deployed source is one bundled file the harness cannot run).
alternative_requiring_a_decision.why_this_is_a_decision: The rule "Edge first" was reviewed on evidence that this round corrected (the deployed number-researcher reports persisted=true, not false). The residuals of database-first are now known and are all on functions with no caller in the 2029 interface or with no cron. Whether to accept them in exchange for stopping the live collector earlier is a decision of ZURIEL; until it is made, the rule stays Edge first.
